title: [Main]- Error The Bin Content does not exist.Not able to post an Inventory Pick for Assemble to Order
summary: Fixed a bug preventing posting of inventory picks for assemble-to-order items by skipping bin content validation for ATO pick lines, which don't have bin content until assembly posting occurs.
key_points: Inventory picks for assemble-to-order items failed with 'The Bin Content does not exist'
The ATO output bin content is created only when the assembly is posted, so it does not exist yet at pick time
Pick lines marked Assemble to Order are now skipped in the bin content check in CheckQuantityInBinContentForTracking
A regression test was added to SCMWhseAsmToOrder
